contrast_screen.basis: WCAG 2.2 contrast mathematics. Applicability depends on use; for example, SC 1.0.01 covers graphical objects required to understand web content.

grayscale_screen.basis: Heuristic CIE L* separation after removing hue. It does not predict all viewing, printing, or color-vision conditions.

notice: No palette can establish accessibility by itself. Preserve labels and add redundant encodings such as markers, line styles, direct labels, or patterns; evaluate the rendered figure in context.
